title: Report an Offline Event
content_data:
Use this endpoint to report an offline event. > **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/offline/track/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Desciption| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `"application/json"`.| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{10%}|Description{40%}|Examples{20%}| | --- | --- | --- | --- | |event {Required}|string |Event type.
Refer to the [Report Offline Events and Parameters-Supported Offline Events](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1758053486938113) section for supported values.|Purchase| |event_set_id {Required} |string |Event Set ID.|7057103914977558530| |event_id|string|A unique value for each event. This ID can be used to match data between partner and TikTok. We suggest it is a String of 32 characters, including numeric digits (0-9), uppercase letters (A-Z), and lowercase letters (a-z).|1616318632825_357| |context{Required} |object | Dictionary of extra information that provides useful context about a message. For the data fields in this object, see the "User context object parameters" section below.|See "User context object parameters" section| |properties{Required}|object |Free-form dictionary of properties of the event, e.g., revenue. For the data fields in this object, see the "Properties object parameters" section below.|See "Properties object parameters" section| |timestamp{Required}|datetime|Timestamp that the event took place. Timestamp with [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format. |2019-06-12T19:11:01.152Z| ``` ### User context object parameters The table below introduces the supported fields in `context` object. **You must pass in either `phone_numbers` or `emails` and provide at least one value for the specified field.** ```xtable |Field{20%}|Data Type{10%}|Description{25%}|Formatting{30%}|Examples{15%}| |---|---|---|---|---| |user{Required}| object|The personal data of a user.| | #|phone_numbers|string[]|User's phone number.
It must be hashed with SHA-256 on the client side. You must pass in either this field or `emails`. |Prior to hashing, format the phone number:
  • Normalize your phone numbers to E.164 format, a combination of + ［country code]［phone number]. An example of a US number in the E.164 format: +12133734253
  • Recommend using [https://github.com/catamphetamine/libphonenumber-js](https://github.com/catamphetamine/libphonenumber-js) for E.164 parsing.
  • Only SHA-256 is accepted. Here is the recommended package: [GitHub - emn178/js-sha256: A simple SHA-256 / SHA-224 hash function for JavaScript supports UTF-8 encoding.](https://github.com/emn178/js-sha256)|["sha256phone1","sha256phone2"]| #|emails|string[]|User's email.
    It must be hashed with SHA-256 on the client side. You must pass in either this field or `phone_numbers`. |Prior to hashing, format the email:
    • You should lowercase all characters before hashing.
    • Do not perform any other types of normalization on emails prior to hashing.
    • Only SHA-256 is accepted. Here is the recommended package: [GitHub - emn178/js-sha256: A simple SHA-256 / SHA-224 hash function for JavaScript supports UTF-8 encoding.](https://github.com/emn178/js-sha256)| ["sha256email1", "sha256email2"]| ``` ### Properties object parameters The table below introduces the supported fields in `properties` object. ```xtable |Field{20%}|Data Type{10%}|Description{35%}|Examples{35%}| |---|---|---|---| |order_id|string| Order ID.|abc_xyz| |shop_id|string|Shop ID. | |contents|object[]|Product or Item array. | #|content_name|string|Name of the product. |socks| #|content_type|string|Product or content type.|product| #|content_category|string|Product or content category.|Men's cloth| #|content_id|string|Product or content identifier.|230222800| #|quantity|number|Number of item.|1| #|price|number|Price of the product or content.|125.05| #|brand|string|Brand name of the product item.| | |currency{+Conditional}|string|ISO 4217 code. Required for revenue reporting. Example: "USD".
      List of currencies currently supported: AED, ARS, AUD, BDT, BHD, BIF, BOB, BRL, CAD, CHF, CLP, CNY, COP, CRC, CZK, DKK, DZD, EGP, EUR, GBP, GTQ, HKD, HNL, HUF, IDR, ILS, INR, ISK, JPY, KES, KHR, KRW, KWD, KZT, MAD, MOP, MXN, MYR, NGN, NIO, NOK, NZD, OMR, PEN, PHP, PHP, PKR, PLN, PYG, QAR, RON, RUB, SAR, SEK, SGD, THB, TRY, TWD, UAH, USD, VES, VND, ZAR.|USD| |value{+Conditional}|number|Revenue of total contents. Required for revenue reporting.|125.05| |event_channel|string|Event channel. Enum values:
      • email
      • website
      • phone_call
      • in_store
      • crm
      • other|in_store| ``` ### Example > **Note**
        You need to replace the dummy data in the example with your own data. ```xcodeblock (code cURL HTTP) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/offline/track/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data-raw '{ "event_set_id":"{{event_set_id}}", "event": "Purchase", "event_id":"{{event_id}}", "timestamp": "2020-09-17T19:49:27Z", "context": { "user": { "phone_numbers": ["2f9d2b4df907e5c9a7b3434351b55700167b998a83dc479b825096486ffcf4ea", "1e7c3b4ff108e5c9a7b3434351b55700167b998a83dc479b825096486cvvf6gt"], "emails": ["dd6ff77f54e2106661089bae4d40cdb600979bf7edc9eb65c0942ba55c7c2d7f"] } }, "properties": { "order_id": "abc_xyz", "shop_id": "123abc", "contents": [ { "price": 8, "quantity": 2, "content_type": "product", "content_id": "1077218", "content_name": "socks", "content_category": "Men's cloth" }, { "price": 30, "quantity": 1, "content_type": "product", "content_id": "1197218", "content_name": "Nike Air Jordan 1", "content_category": "Men's shoes" } ], "event_channel": "in_store", "currency": "USD", "value": 46.00 } } ' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data|object| Error details. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "request_id": "2019091810032301011023224213558", "data":{} } (/code); ```
